method_observation.observation: Replay public/private securities financing as a time-varying state rather than a static capital-provider label. Freight cash flow and vessel value may be unchanged while equity or bond issuance economics open or close because investor risk appetite, market valuation relative to assets and the issuer's capital-allocation alternatives change; collapsing market access into generic available capital hides this transmission channel.

seal_effect.reason: High-importance novelty remains; major coverage gaps, negative-space review and challenger gates remain incomplete.

truth_boundary: Memory-only orientation and not financial advice; no issuer valuation, NAV, security price, issue term, dividend, buyback, ownership position, investor identity, financing availability or current capital-market condition is verified.
